entities.name: Fujiwara no Sanekata
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fujiwara no Sanekata  was a Japanese waka poet of the mid-Heian period. One of his poems was included in the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu. He left a private waka collection, the Sanekata-shū.
